name: com.cometinvest/shariahgrade
title: Comet Invest ShariahGrade
description: Ask if a U.S. stock is halal. Verdict, grade, reasoning and SEC filing sources (AAOIFI SS 21).

tools.name: screen_stock
tools.description: Look up one U.S.-listed stock in the Comet ShariahGrade screen. Returns the verdict and grade, the business-activity finding, the three financial ratios against their limits with the filing each number came from, the Comet Clean Hands Grade, and links to the stock page and methodology. Use this when someone asks whether a specific stock is halal or Shariah-compliant.

symbol.description: U.S. ticker symbol, for example AAPL or BRK-B.

tools.name: compare_stocks
tools.description: Screen up to 10 tickers at once and return each one's verdict, ShariahGrade, the three ratios and the main reason for any failure, side by side. Use this for a list of holdings or a watchlist.

items.description: U.S. ticker symbol, for example AAPL or BRK-B.

tools.name: search_stocks
tools.description: Find stocks in the Comet screen by company name or ticker, optionally filtered by verdict, ShariahGrade, sector or index. Returns up to 50 matches with verdict and grade. Results are ordered alphabetically by ticker, not ranked, and are not recommendations.

query.description: Part of a company name or ticker. Optional.

verdict.description: PASS passes, FAIL fails, REVIEW is questionable (prohibited revenue not disclosed), DATA is a data gap.

sector.description: Sector name, for example Technology or Healthcare.

tools.name: get_methodology
tools.description: Explain how Comet screens a stock: the standard applied, the business-activity screen, the three financial ratios and their limits, how the ShariahGrade letter is assigned, what the Clean Hands Grade is, and where scholars and other screeners differ. Use this to explain a result or the concepts behind Shariah stock screening.

tools.name: get_halal_500
tools.description: List constituents of the Comet Halal 500, a rules-based index of the largest U.S. companies that pass the Comet screen, with weights, sector mix and the reconstitution schedule. Returns holdings and rules only; it does not return or imply performance. You cannot invest directly in an index.

variant.description: Index variant id. Omit for the main Comet Halal 500. Use list_variants to see the others.

limit.description: How many constituents to return, largest weight first.

list_variants.description: Return the available variants instead of constituents.
